nodes.start.options.[odda].text.t: The key is Nipper's. Hand it over and don't be clever.

nodes.start.options.[zatrzymaj].text.t: I'm keeping the key. Nipper will get something else.

nodes.start.text.t: In the half-dark of the culvert someone sits on a stone, playing with a key on a string. "Looking for this? Nipper lost it. I found it. I'll give it back when somebody tells me what he wants it for. And if nobody tells me, I won't, and if I don't, Nipper has no reason to come back to town."

nodes.wynik_odda.text.t: The rat shakes his head, but hands the key over without a fight. "Someone once told me that whoever robs kids ends up in a culvert. I'd rather end up in the culvert standing up." The key lands in your palm.

nodes.wynik_zatrzymaj.text.t: The rat shrugs and tosses you the key. "Your business. But remember, kids have longer memories than grown-ups." You tuck the key in your pocket.
